bullets.text: Digital Transformation Essential – Digital transformation is crucial for UK construction firms to enhance growth and efficiency.
RevOps Drives SaaS Growth – Revenue operations align sales, marketing, and customer success for predictable growth in SaaS.
AI Revolutionising Compliance – Agentic AI is transforming accounting compliance, making tax reporting more efficient and accurate.
Predictive Maintenance Saves Money – Implementing predictive maintenance can significantly reduce downtime costs for manufacturers.
Servitisation Boosts Manufacturing – Integrating services with products helps manufacturers differentiate and enhance customer relationships.
Streamlined Accounting for Manufacturing – Understanding manufacturing costs is vital for improving profitability and operational efficiency.
Sage Acquires Criterion – This acquisition aims to simplify cloud payroll and human capital management for mid-sized businesses.
